in_hebrew.name: גרגס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word גרגס (gargas) which means 'strong, watchful' or 'keeper of the works'. This name is not found in the Bible but it can be derived from the biblical name 'Gregorius' which has a similar meaning.

in_greek.name: Γρηγγοριος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word Γρηγορεω (gregoreo) which means 'to be awake, to watch, to keep watch'. The name Greggs is not directly found in the Bible but it can be derived from the Greek name 'Gregorios' which is mentioned in the New Testament (1 Maccabees 14:27).

in_latin.name: Gregorius
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'gregarius' which means 'watchful, vigilant, guardian'. The name Greggs is not directly found in the Bible but it is derived from the Latin name 'Gregorius' which is mentioned in various scriptures including the New Testament (1 Maccabees 14:27).
